purpose: Canonical workload definitions for repeatable physical-device benchmarking.
principle: Workload definitions describe measurement conditions; they do not authorize optimization actions.

scenarios.label: Idle
operatorProcedure: Leave the device on the normal home/launcher screen.
Do not interact with the device during measurement.

scenarios.label: Normal Application Use
operatorProcedure: Use the device normally with a documented, repeatable set of everyday applications.
Avoid installing, updating, or deleting applications during measurement.
Record the application sequence and timing in the benchmark result.

scenarios.label: Sustained Workload
operatorProcedure: Run a documented, repeatable workload that keeps the device actively occupied.
Use the same workload and duration for before/after comparisons.
Record battery state, temperature, and workload details.

scenarios.label: Gaming
operatorProcedure: Manually run the same game, mode, graphics settings, and test sequence for each comparison.
Keep device brightness, network state, charging state, and game version consistent where practical.
Record game version, graphics settings, and test sequence.

comparisonRules: Use repeated runs rather than a single run.
Keep device model, Android version, app version, and benchmark version recorded.
Separate observations collected under different workloads; do not merge them into one baseline average.
Treat benchmark results as evidence for policy decisions, not as proof of causation.
Do not enable optimization mutation as part of baseline collection.
